messages:
maria: FYI - external pen test scheduled. Assessor requested RBAC mapping, KMS upload guidance, and proof of audit exports. Need a quick ops plan.

devon: Send assessor contact so I can prep temp roles.

maria: DM sent. They want presigned S3 uploads and client-side encrypted artifacts.

chris: We'll lock uploads to a dedicated evidence bucket, block public ACLs, and enable object-lock in Governance for the engagement. Retention 30d.

samir: Do not grant kms:Decrypt. Give GenerateDataKeyEncrypted/Encrypt only so they can upload ciphertext. We'll decrypt internally.

elaine: Eng-sre can snapshot CloudTrail prefix at window start and provide SHA256 of the snapshot for integrity proof.

devon: Creating temporary role 'assessor-readroom' with session TTL=8h. Permissions: S3 PutObject (prefix-restricted), KMS:Encrypt. No Decrypt.

maria: Retest plan? Assessor asked for one brief validation after fixes.

chris: Propose primary window Thu 09:00-13:00 PST, backup Tue 14:00-18:00 PST. We'll open a bridge 15m before start.

samir: I'll PR Terraform for KMS + role with automatic revoke after 8h today.

maria: Volunteers for evidence handoff coordinator? I'll do first 2 hours Thu.

devon: I'll cover the remainder.

chris: Reminder: don't share raw keys in Slack. Use secure docs.

maria: I'll DM the presign instructions once infra is up. Tagging @devon @samir @chris @elaine.

incident-bot: Tip: run `/bridge open pt-assessment` 15 minutes before the window to create the bridge.

maria: Summary -> TF PRs today, bucket + roles by Wed, primary window Thu 09:00-13:00 PST, 1-hour retest within 1 week after fixes. End.
